title: Characterizing features of the genetic architecture underlying autism from a multi-ancestry perspective
title_zh: 从多民族视角刻画自闭症谱系障碍遗传架构的特征
abstract: Autism spectrum disorder (ASD; MIM 209850) is reported to vary globally from 0.01% in East Asian populations to 4.36% in certain Australian cohorts. Despite high heritability estimates (61–94%), the genetic architecture underlying ASD susceptibility remains poorly characterized across diverse populations, as most genomic studies have initially focused on individuals of European ancestry. To investigate ancestry-specific genetic contributions to ASD, we analyzed whole-genome sequencing data from three independent ASD cohorts. We identified admixed ASD probands (n = 1 033) and ancestry-matched controls (n = 1 033) and performed admixture mapping (AM). AM using five continental reference populations (European, African, East Asian, South Asian, and Native American) identified five ancestry-specific ASD-susceptibility loci, including one African-related locus at 1p21.2 near S1PR1 and four Native American-associated loci at chromosome 11q13.4. Three of these latter loci were contiguous and encompassed genes previously implicated in ASD, notably SHANK2 and DHCR7, with fine-mapping identifying a significantly associated variant between the two genes (rs77695321; P = 1.52 × 10⁻⁷). The fourth Native American-associated signal at 11q13.4 overlapped the folate receptor genes FOLR1 and FOLR3, with fine-mapping identifying a genome-wide significant variant (rs7950807; P = 5.21 × 10⁻⁸). A secondary admixture mapping analysis restricted to Latin American individuals, incorporating 6 487 Brazilian controls, identified 16 additional ancestry-specific loci across seven genomic regions.
abstract_zh: 自闭症谱系障碍（ASD；MIM 209850）在全球报告患病率从东亚人群的0.01%到某些澳大利亚队列的4.36%不等。尽管高遗传率估计值（61–94%），但自闭症谱系障碍易感性的遗传架构在不同人群中仍知之甚少，因为大多数基因组研究最初主要集中在欧洲血统个体上。为了研究祖先特异性对自闭症谱系障碍的贡献，我们分析了三个独立自闭症谱系障碍队列的全基因组测序数据。我们鉴定了1 033例混合血统的自闭症谱系障碍患儿和1 033例按祖先匹配的对照，并进行了混合血统映射（AM）。利用五个大陆参考人群（欧洲人、非洲人、东亚人、南亚人和美洲原住民）进行混合血统映射，鉴定出5个自闭症谱系障碍易感性位点，包括一个位于1p21.2附近S1PR1基因的非洲相关位点，以及四个位于11q13.4染色体的美洲原住民相关位点。其中三个后者相邻且包含先前已被证实与自闭症谱系障碍相关的基因，显著基因包括SHANK2和DHCR7，细粒度映射在两基因间鉴定出一个显著关联的变异（rs77695321；P = 1.52 × 10⁻⁷）。第4个位于11q13.4的美洲原住民相关信号重叠于叶酸受体基因FOLR1和FOLR3，细粒度映射鉴定出一个全基因组显著变异（rs7950807；P = 5.21 × 10⁻⁸）。针对拉丁美洲个体的次级混合血统映射分析，纳入了6 487名巴西对照，在七个基因组区域鉴定出16个额外的祖先特异性位点。
